subject: Clay remote execution / sandbox capability surface

findings.finding: SandboxAPI adapter and dedicated capability file existed, and the research-tool bridge already allowlisted sandboxapi_sandbox, but EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_TOOL_REGISTRY and provider_health_audit did not consistently surface it.

The registry described E2B as credential-unavailable while PROVIDER_HEALTH and e2b_verification preserved a successful 2026-08-08 live runtime receipt. Credential health, runtime health and worker invocability had drifted into contradictory status fields.

Current official SandboxAPI documentation uses the direct api.sandboxapi.dev REST endpoint with X-RapidAPI-Key, while the existing adapter only probed RapidAPI gateway hosts. Adapter now probes the current direct endpoint first and retains gateway fallback.

sandboxapi.observed_failure: HTTP 403 not subscribed through RapidAPI gateway
